concerns.text: FR-006 requires a sensitivity analysis sweeping significance thresholds (alpha) over {0.01, 0.05, 0.1} and outputting mean rank/std dev. Task T033 implements this, but T034b (script wrapper) is marked [ ] (unimplemented) and T035 (logging SC-001/002/003) is also [ ]. Without T034b, the sensitivity analysis results cannot be aggregated into the required JSON, leaving FR-006 and SC-005 unfulfilled.

FR-005 requires permutation importance analysis. Task T030 implements the function, but T036 (unit test scaffolding) is marked [ ] (unimplemented). While tests are optional per the header, the spec's 'Independent Test' for US3 explicitly requires verifying the output JSON. Without T036, the verification step for FR-005 is missing from the task plan.

FR-007 requires including textual covariates (caption length, noun phrase count) in the regression model. Task T046 implements the feature extraction, and T047 updates the model to accept them. However, T047 is marked [ ] (unimplemented). Without T047, the model in T029a will not include the required covariates, violating FR-007.

FR-008 requires a sensitivity analysis on human rating noise. Task T048 implements noise injection, and T049 implements the re-training loop. Both T048 and T049 are marked [ ] (unimplemented). This leaves the entire FR-008 requirement unaddressed in the task plan.

FR-009 requires validating the uncertainty proxy against a baseline. Task T050a (acquire baseline) and T050 (validate) are marked [ ] (unimplemented). T051 (update features.py to call T050) is also [ ]. The entire construct validity check (FR-009) is missing from the implementation tasks.

The plan includes Phase 8 (Integration & Final Validation) with tasks T052 (End-to-End Pipeline), T053 (Final Report), T054 (Documentation), and T055 (Reproducibility). All are marked [ ] (unimplemented). While these are 'finalization' tasks, the spec's 'Independent Test' for US3 requires a 'comprehensive final report' (T053) and the 'Implementation Strategy' requires a full pipeline run (T052). Their absence means the project cannot be validated end-to-end.

Task T004b appears twice: once in Phase 1 (Contract Test Scaffolding) and again in Phase 7 (Error Message Factory). The Phase 7 entry is a duplicate/fragment that redefines the task scope. This creates ambiguity about whether the error factory is implemented in Phase 1 or Phase 7, and the Phase 7 entry is marked [ ] (unimplemented) while Phase 1 is [X]. This is a documentation inconsistency.
